investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1-3.9.1, gssapi) with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents'. percona/pmm#6109 (PMM-15484, merged 11-09 15:16) added that table to MongoDB Backup Details; it lists only failing PBM agents, and the run's page snapshot shows it in its healthy 'No failing backup agents' state. MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics is empty, so the generic all-panels check flags it. The fix (noDataMetrics = ['Failing Backup Agents']) is already in draft pmm-qa#1740, which was blocked on pmm#6109 and can now be made ready. Deduped from the run artifacts, not re-reproduced.

upgrade 3.7.0 (UI + Docker): PMM-T2385 found ReplSet Summary 'State'/'Version' empty for rs102/rscfg01 (UI) and rs202 (Docker), and the UI leg's 'Verify grafana logs after upgrade' found 'failed to save dashboard' (the nights 100/102 signature). Same cause as those nights, now worse: upgrade_clients.sh dnf-installs pmm-client in 13 containers at once, only on 3.6.0/3.7.0 (tarball-installed because not in apt), and took 720/794 s vs 409/410 s last night and ~60 s on 3.7.1+. In that window the Docker leg's pmm-managed logged 320 'GET :3000/api/auth/serviceaccount: context deadline exceeded' on the /victoriametrics auth path (01:00-01:07), Grafana's PG statements were cancelled, and pings failed to every pmm-agent, so the exporters' remote writes were refused. The re-run (attempt 2) passed both legs: UI with a 395 s upgrade, Docker with 797 s, so the stall is intermittent in effect and was reproduced in duration. No fix yet: the step's slowness still needs root-causing on a CHAOS VM (per-container dnf logs are discarded on success). PMM-T2185 (RTA sort) was flaky on retry in both attempts.

ha backup-restore #40: PMM-T2377 failed in its first step, 'At least one service must be monitored', 10 s into the test. The trace shows the up query (max by service_name of timestamp(up==1)) returned only 2 internal HA services, both last sampled at 00:55:00, 168 s before the check (cutoff 120 s). The ps/psmdb services registered at 00:56:58-00:57:37 had no up sample yet. pmm-managed logged the internal PostgreSQL shutting down / refusing connections / read-only in recovery at 00:55:12, right after the PG pods rolled at 00:54-00:55, so ingestion had not resumed when the test started. The setup-to-test gap (~10 s) is the same as in the green #38/#39. The servicesRunningAndReporting check is one-shot, with no wait. The re-run #41 with identical parameters passed T2377 (13.5 m).

ui @instances #12104: PMM-T2010 'Verify Dashboard for Aurora Postgres RDS added via UI' failed only for the Aurora PostgreSQL 16 instance (the PG15 one passed): 'Execution time' empty on PostgreSQL Instances Overview over now-5m, about 40 s after the instance was added. Not reproduced: the re-run #12106 with identical parameters passed. The panel depends on query activity on the external AWS Aurora instance inside a 5-minute window, which the test does not generate; if it recurs, that is the next thing to check.
